content.text: “Na waing muc noine. Nga Mamacti waing bolele fileine.
Muc mangngine gocne nala falu noine mi aibong, ye yogo sasawa welockelu wicebacaigac. Nga mangngine gocne noine aicaigaing, yogo sasawa noine bocyac ainingte, ye yogo bamadicebame madickedaingte.
Na mic-yowa edocngebacaigabacte ngenge biyac gbagbacne aiibong gagabiyeng.

Ailu ngenge naholec wetackelu gadabiyeng. Inguc aibong nani ngengeholec wetackelu gadacte. Waing muc mangnginedi mucina mi bakatackedaictewa, ye noine nalic mi aidaicte. Ingucnehac ngenge naholec mi wetackelu gadaingtewa, noine monic mi aidaingte.
“Naneuc waing mucine, aime ngengibac mangngine. Monic ye naholec wetackelu game, nani yeholec inguchac wetackelu gabe, ye noine bocyac aidaicte. Ngenge na mikac bole monic nalic mi badaingte.
Monic ye naholec mi wetackelu gadaictewa, ye ngicti mangngine helockelu wickebong homacaigac, yogo ingucnehac ye helockelu wickedaingte. Aime mangngine ingucne kpaduckelu dacka wickebong lobedaicte.
Ngenge naholec wetackelu gadaingte. Aime nale yowa ngengela wetackelu fadaictewa, wiyac monicte aingeleme uwabong, yogo fikengeledaicte.
Ailu ngenge noine bocyac bafuwalu mic-tengtengfocne yegengkegaingte Mamacti aibaba yogolec wac feicnehac bagac.
“Mamacti kweleinedi nale angackeme aicaigac, silicine ingucnehac nani kwelenedi ngengele angacnume aicaigabac. Ngenge nale kwele-angac kwelina wetackelu gadabiyeng.
Na Mamacnele ung-yowa balaibelu yele kwele-angac kwelina wetackelu gacaigabac. Yogo ingucnehac ngengi nale ung-yowa balaibedaingtewa, nale kwele-angacte kwelina wetackelu gadaingte.
Nale belic-belicti ngengela fagac. Aime kwelengineng sasawa belic-belicti fangelenale yowa yago edocngebagabac.
“Nale ung-yowa yanguc, na ngenge ago aingelelu kwele-angacka gacaigabac, silicine ingucnehac ngenge ago ainagulu kwele-angacka gadabiyeng.
Monic ye agofocine yengele ailu gagaine hegiledaicte, yele kwele-angac yogo feicnebenang.
Aime na ung-yowa ngelecaigabac, yogo balaibegaingka ngenge nale agofocne aigaing.

“Kwelec kwekwe ye sugucneinedi wiyac aicaigac, yogo mi ngagedaicte. Ilec ailu na ngengele kwelec kwekwe madec hatacmac mi midacte, miyac. Na ngengele agofocne migabac. I yangucte, na Mamacnelacni yowa ngageiba, yogo sasawa biyachac edocngebayackeiba.

Ngengi na mi bawosaecnuibong, miyac. Ngenge noine bafuwaningte ailu nani bawosaecngebalu bolewa locngebaiba. Noine bafuwabong yogodi fafa-sanang faginowagac. Ilec ailu ngenge wiyac monicte nale wacka Mamac milockebong, yedi wiyac yogo ngeledaicte.
Aime na ung-yowa yanguc ngelegabac, ngenge ngengileng ago ainagulu kwele-angacka gadabiyeng.
“Himongtowa yagolec ngic-ngigac yengi kweledi wicngebagaingka, ngenge yanguc ngagedaing, molickelu na inguchac kweledi wicnuibong.

Ngenge himongtowa yagolec ngic-ngigac gadabongka, yenge yengileng aiyelecaigac, silicine ingucnehac ngengele angac ngagedabongka. Nga ngengebac himongtowa yagowacni miyac, nani ngenge biyachac bawosaecngebalu himongtowa yagolec ngic-ngigac yengelacni baicngebaiba. Ilec ailu yengi ngenge kweledi wicngebadaingte.

Na yowa molickelu edocngebaiba, yogo mi ngigecngebadaic, kwelec kwekwe ngic monicti sugucneinele feicne mi aidaicte. Ilec ailu ngic-ngigac yengi weyebic aineleibongka, yenge silicine ingucnehac ngenge weyebic aingeledaingte. Aime nale yowa balaibeibongka, ngengele yowa ingucnehac balaibedaingte.
Yenge salecnuwec, ye mi ngagegaing. Ilec yenge nale wacte ailu ngenge inguc aingeledaingte.
“Na walu yengela yowane mi midackabac, yenge bikicnginengte umac mikac gadabong. Aime yakumacbac walu mibe bikicnginengte ailu migbedic ainogale yefe monic mi fagac.
Monic ye na kweleinedi wicnugac, ibac ye Mamacne inguchac kweleinedi wickegac.

Na bole balu gagabac yogo monicti pasi tapiliineholec ingucne biyachac esecne monic mi bawec, pasi ingucne yogo yengele hewacka mi badacka, ibac yenge bikicnginengte umac mikac gadabong. Aime yenge pasine yogo yakumac nganilubac Mamacneholec noke kwelenginengti wicnupagaing.
Aime yowa yanguc fagac,
‘Yenge fungine mikacka kwelenginengti mocbenang wicnuibong.’
Yogo yefe-yowanginang kwelengkeicne fagac. Aime yogo sasawa noine fikenale inguc aiibong.
“Ngic-hewacngineng kwesidaicte, ye Mamactacni salengelebe kwesidaicte. Ailu yedi hocne yowa noinele Asu. Aime yedi kwesilu nale mime yegengkedaicte.
Aime ngenge molickelu naholec gaibong. Ilec ngengi inguchac nale mibong yegengkedaic.”
